Spray Dried Coriander Powder for Seasoning and Food Manufacturing

Tradenest Naturals produces spray dried coriander powder for seasoning houses, snack makers and ready-meal producers. The powder is made with a spray drying process designed to hold on to coriander's warm, citrusy aroma. Compared with plain ground seed, it is finer, flows more freely and disperses more evenly. Each batch is made to the same specification for mesh, moisture and flavor strength, so your recipes behave the same way every time.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Coriander Powder?

As a spray dried coriander powder manufacturer, we know large-scale food production depends on steady inputs. Regular ground coriander can clump and lose aroma over time. Our spray dried version stays free-flowing in sealed packs. That suits automated dosing systems in snack and seasoning plants. The drying process also helps hold the aroma within the powder, so the flavor carries through to the finished product. If you need a bulk spray dried coriander powder supplier India can offer at export scale, Tradenest Naturals is ready to help. Our coriander seed is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. It is then processed and spray dried under controlled conditions. Full composition details are listed on the specification sheet. This helps your team check the powder against clean-label targets before approval.

Advanced Manufacturing and Quality Control

Our process follows clear steps. First, coriander seed is cleaned and sorted. Second, the flavor is drawn out under controlled conditions. Third, the liquid is atomized into a hot air stream. Water is removed almost instantly, which leaves fine, even particles. Drying is fast, so heat exposure stays short. Every batch is checked in-house for moisture and particle size, and each lot carries a batch number for traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This open approach is why importers use us as a spray dried coriander powder exporter. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our wholesale spray dried coriander powder is used across many sectors. With its fine texture and easy dispersion, it works well in:
  • Seasoning Blends: Snack seasonings, instant noodle masalas and spice mixes.
  • Ready-to-Eat Meals: Even flavor in gravies, soups and sauces without lumps.
  • Beverage Industry: Herbal and botanical drink formulations.
  • Meat Processing: Marinades, sausages and processed meat products.
  • Nutraceuticals: A botanical ingredient for dietary supplement blends.

Buyer Information and FAQ

We want buying to be simple. Here are answers to the questions our B2B customers ask most often:

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried coriander powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger orders bring better pricing, and we also supply small lots for R&D or private label work. Contact us for a quote.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter, and we provide export documentation support. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer 25 kg bulk bags, HDPE containers and OEM or private label pouches. Moisture-barrier packing gives a shelf life of 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place.

What are the typical specifications?

The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. The full specification sheet comes with every quotation for your quality team.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample?

Lead time depends on order volume and packing requirements. Samples are available on request. To ask for a sample or a formal quote, use our website contact form.
